_: Every threshold the office uses, in one file. The reader reads THIS file; a threshold that lives anywhere else is a defect. Your own settings (names, machines, privacy) are in workspace.config.json, not here.

poll._heartbeat: The server emits a frame every heartbeat_ms even when nothing changed. Silence is how the client knows it has gone blind.

blind._: No frame for this long and the whole page greys out and says it is reconnecting. 3x the heartbeat.

liveness._waiting: A session past the floor that is waiting on a background command or a ScheduleWakeup timer IT started renders WAITING, not idle - it will wake itself. Only for this long (65 min: ScheduleWakeup's 60-min cap plus slack); past it the normal floor applies, because a session that died mid-wait never writes the finish.
liveness._: A desk with no event of ANY kind for this long renders STALE regardless of what the event stream last implied. It is the only defence against a session that exits on max_turns and never emits Stop. Not to be optimised away.

staleness._: Past default_max_age_ms a fact is STALE with its explicit age. Past 3x it is demoted to NOT READ with the value REMOVED, never greyed-but-present.

alarms._: Conditions the office watches for. They are not shown on the page; the idle nudge and the stall logic read them.

wake._wait: bin/office-wake-hook.js waits this long after a Stop for a note, then exits 0 (8 h). Its own Stop hook registration needs a timeout at least this long, in seconds.
wake.nudge_text: The office sees you idle with nothing armed. Check your next step, or reply IDLE-OK.
wake._nudge: Opt-in idle nudge (src/server/nudge.js): a desk with Keep awake on (default on for run seats), its waiter live, idle past alarms.lane_idle_wall_ms with no wakeup, background job or helper, and not waiting on the owner or a permission prompt, gets nudge_text once per idle window, at most nudge_max_per_hour in any hour.

mesh._: One office for every machine (mesh.js). Spokes POST their floor to the hub over the tailnet every interval and declare that interval in the feed. Past stale_multiple x it, that machine's desks are demoted to stale and notes to them stop being offered; past drop_multiple x they leave the floor. Which machine is the hub, and its address, are in workspace.config.json (machines, hub_url).

ui._: Over this many desks the office stops drawing rooms and shows a table.
